core_obligations: Compatibility with flat base change: work locally on Y by lemma-action-opens (tag 0H67) so Y is affine and beta is a finite combination of prime cycles, reduce to beta = [Z] by bilinearity (lemma-action-bilinear, tag 0H66); expand both alpha cap beta and its base change through the generic-point multiplicities (beta' = sum n_a [Z'_a], alpha'_{y'_a} = sum m_j m_{jab} [V'_{jab}]), so the equality reduces to (1) the components of the base change of the closure being the closures of the components and (2) the multiplicity being n_a m_{jab}; transport both claims along the birational morphism V_j to its closure, whose base change is flat and bijective on components with preserved multiplicities; the remaining claim is the commutative square of cycle groups under base change by the generic point and flat pullback, proved in chow-lemma-pullback-base-change-pullback (tag 0FVK). Compatibility with flat pullback is the special case S = Y, S' = Y' of the same argument (proof lines 2263-2356).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to Y affine via lemma-action-opens and to prime beta via lemma-action-bilinear (proof lines 2276-2284).
Expand alpha cap beta and alpha' cap beta' through generic-fibre multiplicities and isolate the two component and multiplicity claims (proof lines 2286-2320).
Transport the claims through the birational morphism V_j into its closure using flatness of the base change (proof lines 2321-2332).
Conclude by the named commutative square chow-lemma-pullback-base-change-pullback and read flat pullback off as the special case S = Y (proof lines 2332-2356).
